status.previous_design_review_scope: The previous pass applies only to its recorded file SHAs and 9+6 schedule; no automatic inheritance by this 12+3 amendment.

model.boundary: after norm2/AdaLN, before W1; return pre-gate; one current gate write
model.axis_semantics: latent time=21; decoded video frames=81; denoising steps=4; distinct axes

cohorts.exposure: All listed CAL/DEV sources are development-exposed; no fresh confirmation claim

local_split.fixed_probe_policy: NumPy default_rng(seed=42).permutation of sorted candidate global IDs; first 64
local_split.independent_unit: source; aggregate folds then six sites within source

observed_readout.feature_form: [z_K, GELU_tanh(z_K)-beta*z_K] / CAL_scale; then frozen effective basis T_CAL
observed_readout.static_control: same C0/Phi0 and BF16 arithmetic; no observer
observed_readout.ridge_selection: CAL leave-one-source-out prior refit and paired query; features already CAL-exposed
observed_readout.tau_rule: max(0.01,sqrt(CAL equal-source per-feature whitened BF16-vs-FP64 difference energy))
observed_readout.zero_feature_scale_policy: sigma=1 with inactive mask; drop zero directions through frozen T_CAL; exclude only wholly zero channel pairs

native_modes.mode_fit: 11 sourcewise hidden response PCG solutions; action-metric POD top4
native_modes.prior: CAL pooled theta_static for the same modes
native_modes.ridge_selection: CAL leave-one-source-out theta_static refit, actual deployed query
native_modes.static_control: same U0/Y0 and compile order with theta_static; no observer
native_modes.dynamic_matrix_compile: FP32, TF32 disabled; final current matrix BF16

video_stages.trigger: Both full80 families completed AND continuous human review completed AND (a functional candidate retained OR an explicit unresolved six-site/full80 coverage question recorded before this branch) AND native bindings and budget valid; bad MSE alone never triggers

video_utility.scope: DEV3 exploratory matched-static comparison; all sources development-exposed
video_utility.primary_evidence: Blinded continuous complete-video functional review with concrete intervals and defect descriptions
video_utility.source0392_functional_improvement: Reduce additional fragmentation while preserving intended dizziness/ghosting and action
video_utility.metric_human_conflict_status: METRIC_HUMAN_DISAGREEMENT; preserve evidence, no automatic scalar verdict

budget.count_semantics: Successful complete configurations and their NFE; failed partial attempts are separately recorded and not bounded by successful-count arithmetic.
budget.retry_policy: No automatic additional complete restarts; any necessary full retry requires a separate finite registered scope and additional budget before execution. Record all failed and successful consumption.

stop_rules: invalid asset/numerical path is an execution issue, not method falsification
finite local MSE regression or no local oracle gain never cancels a fixed family full80 comparison
complete both families full80 static/online DEV3; one family result never cancels the other
only after all full80 and continuous human review, run at most three fixed scope videos if the recorded coverage question warrants them
HUMAN_REVIEW_PENDING is not failure and never triggers the optional branch
close this construction scope after fixed comparisons and any warranted scope branch; no previous P3 or new loss/rank/probe/bank grids

local_oracle.label_access: oracle only; explicitly uses query labels
local_oracle.continuous_lower_bound: same Xb or Db/template, same query target and gate; continuous linear class only
local_oracle.quantized_oracle: report after actual frozen quantization/compile, not a proven discrete optimum
local_oracle.role: Local Euclidean response diagnostic only; never a video eligibility gate or functional lower bound

student_query.ids: same IDs across matched arms for each source; exclude union of method fixed64 and canonical Global-P64 64
student_query.teacher: post-generation 64-row Dense, own producer and batch identity; not full-M shadow

review_scope: Independently reviewed amendment: local metric role, mathematical/evidence interpretation, fixed 12-video two-family full80 comparison, optional 3-video scope branch and functional assessment. Previous review remains limited to its recorded SHAs. Not approval of an unimplemented native producer or evidence of model results.

construction_objective.role: Frozen Euclidean response-fit controls, not video-functional optimality
construction_objective.failure_scope: Only these concrete feature/mode classes and fitting rules; not all state-conditioned operators

required: correct BF16/FP32 path, cache and one current gate write
legal probe information and matched static arithmetic
available resources within registered finite scope

family_comparison_rule: Both fixed families receive static/online full80 DEV3 comparisons; no local-score selection and no cancellation based on the first family video outcome.
